targets.old_statement: The general roundabout rule puts straight-through traffic in the middle lane, but at a two-lane roundabout you follow the pavement markings, arrows or signs to go straight.
targets.old_spoken_statement: The general roundabout rule puts straight-through traffic in the middle lane, but at a two-lane roundabout you follow the pavement markings, arrows or signs to go straight.
targets.statement: At a two-lane roundabout, use the left lane for left turns or U-turns, use the right lane for right turns, and follow the pavement markings, arrows, or signs to go straight.
